# Nexus Defenders

A small canvas shooter. The ship has a health bar and an
optional shield; each hit costs the damage its source deals.

Run it with `npm start`. Play a seeded run with
`node scripts/play.js --seed 4242`.

head.title: Buggy Game

notes.title: Known Bug
items: Any hit destroys the ship at once, from a small asteroid chunk to an enemy shot. It should only cost health.

steps.content:
# Nexus Defenders: description

## Overview
A small canvas shooter. One ship with a health bar and
an optional shield, enemies that fire, asteroids, a score.

## Map
| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `src/game.js` | One frame: move, hazards, hits |
| `src/damage.js` | The damage table and what a hit does |
| `src/hazards.js` | Asteroids and timed hazards |
| `src/render.js` | Draws a frame, never changes state |
| `scripts/play.js` | Plays a seeded run headless |

## Hit Flow
1. `game.js` finds each hit on the ship and its source.
2. It calls `applyHit(ship, source)` in `damage.js`.
3. The returned ship replaces the old one.

## Notes
- No automated tests: `npm test` finds nothing to run.
- `applyHit` has a TODO: it predates health.
- `hazards.js` can end a run on its own (`explodeShip`).

steps.content:
# Review

## P1: Fatal First Hit
**Where**: `src/damage.js`, `applyHit`
**Rule broken**: a hit costs the damage its source deals (README).

- `applyHit` returns `destroyed: true` for every hit.
- `DAMAGE`, `ship.health`, and `ship.shield` are never read.

### Reproduction
`node scripts/play.js --seed 4242 --until first-hit`
ends at tick 512: a 6-damage chunk, with 100 health left.

## P2: Unprovoked Explosion
**Where**: `src/hazards.js`, `tickHazards`

- A self-test from the debris prototype calls
  `explodeShip(state, 'self-test')` at random after tick 1200.
- With hits ignored, 37 of 50 seeded runs of 20,000 ticks
  were destroyed with no hit, the first at tick 1386.

## Not checked
- Rendering and input: outside what a seeded run can see.

script.text:
## Review Findings

### P1: Fatal First Hit
**Where:** `src/damage.js`, `applyHit`

- Every hit returns `destroyed: true`; the damage table, health, and shield are never read.
- Seed 4242 ends at tick 512 on a **6-damage chunk with 100 health left**.

### P2: Unprovoked Explosion
**Where:** `src/hazards.js`, `tickHazards`

- A leftover **self-test** calls `explodeShip(state, 'self-test')` at random after tick 1200.
- With hits ignored, **37 of 50** long runs were destroyed with no hit.

Full report: `docs/review.md`.

head.title: Fix Plan
head.now: The agent writes a phased plan with a definition of done.

stages.why: Sequencing two fixes with their checks needs care, but both problems are already understood.

script.argument: Fix both findings in docs/review.md: a hit should cost health from the damage table instead of destroying the ship, and the ship must never explode without a hit. The map is in docs/describe.md.

steps.content:
# Plan: damage fix

**Version**: v1.1.0
**Goal**: a hit costs health; nothing else ends the run.
**Sources**: docs/describe.md, docs/review.md (P1, P2)

## Phase 1: Health and Shield (P1)
- `applyHit` takes the damage from `DAMAGE`: the shield
  absorbs first, then health; the run ends at zero.
- A short invulnerability window follows a hit (60 ticks).
- Check: seed 4242 survives its first hit.

## Phase 2: Self-Test Removal (P2)
- Delete the self-test block, its two constants, and the
  `explodeShip` import from `hazards.js`.
- Asteroid movement must not change.

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Seed 4242 survives its first hit (100 to 94 health)
- [ ] No run is destroyed without a hit (50 seeds x 20,000 ticks)
- [ ] Tests pin both rules and fail on v1.0.0
- [ ] v1.1.0 is tagged

| Test | Pins |

| a hit costs its damage | 100 to 94 on a chunk |
| the shield absorbs first | beam: shield 20 to 0, health 90 |
| nothing while invulnerable | the window holds |

Each test **fails on v1.0.0**, so neither bug can come back unnoticed.
